title: Parameters
blurb: Named numbers with limits drive the model; change one and the part rebuilds.
alt: A teal plate with rounded corners and three evenly spaced holes.

title: Extrude
blurb: A flat sketch, holes included, pushed up into a solid.
alt: A teal rounded block with a round hole through its top.

title: Revolve
blurb: A profile turned about an axis, here three quarters of the way round.
alt: A teal flanged bushing with a quarter cut away to show its profile.

title: Sweep
blurb: A section carried along a path of lines and arcs.
alt: A teal tube with a smooth right-angle bend, its open end visible.

title: Loft
blurb: One solid stretched through several cross-sections.
alt: A teal vase-like solid that narrows in the middle and widens again.

title: Booleans
blurb: Join two solids, cut one from the other, or keep only the overlap.
alt: A block and cylinder joined, the block with the cylinder cut out, and their overlap in amber.

title: Threads
blurb: Bolts and nuts from the standard library carry real helical threads.
alt: A teal hex bolt with a visible thread and an amber nut part way up it.

title: Chamfer
blurb: Pick edges by the face they belong to and cut them back to a flat.
alt: A teal block whose top edges are bevelled.

title: Fillet
blurb: Round the edges you select, each set with its own radius.
alt: A teal block with rounded corners and a softly rounded top edge.

title: Mirror
blurb: Model one half and reflect it across a plane.
alt: A teal bracket half with a hole and its amber mirror image beside it.

title: Linear pattern
blurb: Copies of a body stepped along a direction.
alt: Five amber pegs in a row on a teal strip.

title: Circular pattern
blurb: Copies spaced around an axis, used here to cut a ring of holes.
alt: A teal disc with eight holes in a circle.

title: Sketch constraints
blurb: Describe a profile by its relationships and sizes; the solver finds the shape.
alt: A teal L-shaped block with a small hole near one end.

title: Offset
blurb: Grow or shrink an outline by a set distance to make walls and rims.
alt: A teal L-shaped floor with an amber wall of even thickness around it.

title: Text
blurb: Lettering becomes ordinary geometry you can raise, cut or engrave.
alt: A teal nameplate with the word CADPOLE in raised amber letters.

title: Emboss
blurb: Artwork wrapped around a curved face and raised from it.
alt: A teal cylinder with the number 42 raised on its curved side.

title: Smooth blend
blurb: Shapes described as distance fields merge with a soft radius.
alt: A teal post flowing smoothly into a rounded base.

title: Twist
blurb: A field turned steadily about its axis, then turned into a mesh.
alt: A teal rounded bar twisted along its height.

title: Section
blurb: Cut a part on a plane to see inside it.
alt: A teal spool cut in half, showing its bore and flanges.

title: Drawing
blurb: Dimensioned three-view sheets, written out as PDF and DXF.
alt: A line drawing with top, front, right and pictorial views of a flanged boss, dimensioned in inches.
